faq.description: Sɛ w'asɛmmisa nni ha a, afotuo bere bɛboa ma woahu nea wohia.
faq.0.question: Nsom bɛn na Nocoding betumi ayɛ?
faq.0.answer: Yɛyɛ ankorankoro adwuma kratafa anaa CV wɛbsaet, landing page anaa adwumakuw ho kratafa, nsɛm ne adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe, ne adwumayɛ kwan a ɛyɛ ne ho.
faq.1.question: Bere ben na adwuma no gye?
faq.1.answer: Ankorankoro adwuma kratafa, CV anaa landing page a ɛyɛ mmerɛ taa gye adwuma nna 1-3 sɛ nneɛma no ayɛ krado. Adwuma akɛse no gyina nneɛma a wohia, nkabom ne bere a wɔde bɛma nsusuiɛ so.
faq.2.question: Wobetumi asesa nhyehyɛe ne nneɛma no?
faq.2.answer: Aane. Wobetumi asesa nhyehyɛe, nkratafa nhyehyɛe, nneɛma titiriw ne adwumayɛ kwan sɛnea wo ahiade te. Yɛne wo bɛhwɛ nhyehyɛe no ansa na adwuma no afi ase.
faq.3.question: Dɛn na ɛka boɔ no ho?
faq.3.answer: Boɔ no fa adwuma no ho sɛnea pakɛte ne nea yɛpene so te. Pakɛte Ketewa no ka hwɛ ho adwuma kwa ne domain afe 1 ho, na Pakɛte Kɛse no ka hwɛ ho adwuma kwa ne hosting afe 1 ho.

project.description.ineedsave: Wɛbsaet a wɔntua ho ka a wɔde download vidio, mfonini ne nne firi TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X ne platfɔm afoforo so. Fa link no to hɔ, paw kwaliti no, na kora so.
project.category.ineedbarcode: Barcode ne QR code yɛbea wɛbsaet
project.description.ineedbarcode: Barcode ne QR code yɛfoɔ a wɔntua ho ka a barcode ahorow 100+ wɔ mu. Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no de data hyɛ mu, sesa design no, na wɔdownload PNG a ɛwɔ hɔ ma printing.
